decisions.reason: Restricting filler content to supplied images does not change the completed magazine-template requirement.
The instruction concerns filler for article-ending white space, not the general assembly behavior, content inputs, or Flat Plan reference.

The same message independently establishes the Heyzine white-label and client-upload workflow, which is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the filler-content change adds no further impact.
Using only supplied images as article-ending filler does not alter inclusion or placement of the supplied tribute page.
The filler-content restriction does not change which cover-mentioned articles must be included or how their placement is determined.
The source decision does not change category-label display, placement, allowed categories, or any article-category mapping.
Choosing images rather than additional text for white-space correction does not modify the approved Inter font or its readable treatment.
The filler-image instruction does not affect author-name, author-photo, identity-matching, source, or placement requirements.
The decision about article-ending filler does not change the Civic Lantern website as the source of article content.
Specifying supplied images and no extra text for article-ending gaps does not change the requirement that advertisements render clearly.
The filler-content choice does not alter the required two-page spread behavior or even page-count constraint.
The instruction to use only supplied filler images does not change the table-of-contents completion condition or finalized-pagination basis.
